state.title: Physical Oceanography Data from Nuup Kangerlua (SW Greenland), 2018–2019
state.description:
This data is collected during monthly transect by the Greenland Climate Research Centre (https://gcrc.gl/), part of the long-term hydrographic research program in Nuup Kangerlua. 
For more information reach out to John Mortensen (jomo@natur.gl) or Lorenz Meire (LoMe@natur.gl).
Data is from period 2018-06-06 to 2019-06-04. 

# name 1 = Cast: Cast name
# name 2 = Date: YYYYMMDD, date of collection
# name 3 = Latitude: Latitude in decimal degrees
# name 4 = Longitude: Longitude in decimal degrees
# name 5 = Year: year
# name 6 = Month: month
# name 7= Day: day of the month
# name 8= Time: time (format HH:MM) in UTC
# name 9 = SBEtime: time in julian days from start of year
# name 10 = Pressure: Pressure, Strain Gauge [db]
# name 11 = Temperature: Temperature [ITS-90, deg C]
# name 12 = Salinity: Salinity, Practical [PSU]
# name 13 = Density: Density [density, kg/m^3]
